heading_fil: Tubig at kuryente na may pag-iingat
display_fil: Ayusin ang leak at patayin ang hindi kailangang ilaw ayon sa facility instruction. Panatilihin ang cold chain, kinakailangang bentilasyon at handwashing water. Ang kritikal na serbisyo ay hindi dapat isakripisyo.
display_en: Repair leaks and switch off unnecessary lights according to facility instructions. Preserve cold chain, required ventilation and handwashing water. Essential service safeguards must remain.

check.prompt_fil: May vaccine refrigerator sa BHS at mataas ang bill. Aling mungkahi ang ligtas na siyasatin?
check.prompt_en: The BHS has a vaccine refrigerator and a high electricity bill. Which proposal is safe to investigate?

options.fil: Panatilihing gumagana ang refrigerator; suriin ang hindi kailangang ilaw at sundin ang facility procedure.
options.en: Keep the refrigerator running; check unnecessary lights under facility procedure.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ay tumutukoy sa hindi kailangang konsumo habang protektado ang cold chain. Ang pagpatay sa refrigerator o kinakailangang bentilasyon ay maaaring makasira sa ligtas na serbisyo.
check.feedback_en: The first response targets unnecessary use while protecting the cold chain. Switching off the refrigerator or required ventilation can compromise safe service.

heading_fil: Bawasan ang hindi kailangan, panatilihin ang ligtas
display_fil: Reusable teaching visual: maaaring makatipid. Single-use clinical item: hindi gawing reusable. Sundin ang BHS policy at segregation. Kapag hindi tiyak, itanong sa supervisor ang aprubadong paraan.
display_en: A reusable teaching visual can reduce waste. Clinical single-use items must stay single-use. Follow BHS policy and segregation. If uncertain, ask the supervisor for the approved approach.

heading_fil: Ayusin ang daloy, hindi bilisan lang
heading_en: Improve the flow, not just the speed
display_fil: Suriin ang approved version bago mag-print; ihanda nang magkakasama ang gamit. Maaaring pagsabayin ang delivery sa ligtas na ruta, ngunit hindi ipagpaliban ang urgent referral. Sukatin ang kalidad at oras, hindi bilis lang.
display_en: Check the approved version before printing and assemble materials together. Combine deliveries on a safe route when suitable, but never delay urgent referral. Measure quality and time, not speed alone.

display_fil: Posibleng sanhi: lumang kopya o maling pagpili. Suriin ang printout at master; kausapin ang nag-print. Beripikahin sa supervisor bago baguhin ang routine.
display_en: Possible causes: old copy or wrong selection. Check printouts against the master and consult the printer. Verify with the supervisor before changing the routine.

display_fil: Matitipid? Posibleng pinsala? Safeguard? Piliin ang pagbabawas ng waste na nagpapanatili ng ligtas at napapanahong serbisyo.
display_en: Savings? Potential harm? Safeguard? Choose waste reduction that preserves safe, timely services.

display_fil: Makatipid sa waste at rework; panatilihin ang proteksyon at serbisyong kailangan.
display_en: Reduce waste and rework while preserving essential protection and services.

check.prompt_fil: Gustong bawasan ang papel sa health teaching. Aling mungkahi ang angkop?
check.prompt_en: The team wants to reduce paper in health teaching. Which proposal fits?

options.fil: Huwag nang magbigay ng kailangang instruction para mabawasan ang pahina.
options.en: Omit needed instructions to reduce pages.

options.fil: Gamitin ang lumang bersyon hanggang maubos.
options.en: Use the old version until it runs out.

options.fil: Suriin ang approved version at gumamit ng aprubadong reusable visual kung angkop.
options.en: Check the approved version and use an approved reusable visual where suitable.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikatlong sagot ay binabawasan ang rework habang tama ang impormasyon. Ang pagtanggal ng kailangan o paggamit ng lumang bersyon ay maaaring magpababa ng kalidad kahit mas kaunti ang papel.
check.feedback_en: The third response reduces rework while keeping information correct. Omitting essentials or using an old version can lower quality even when less paper is used.
